name: Club
description: A simple wooden bludgeon. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Dagger
description: A versatile blade easily concealed. 2024 Mastery: Nick.

name: Greatclub
description: A heavy two-handed club or maul. 2024 Mastery: Push.

name: Handaxe
description: A light throwing axe. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Javelin
description: A light spear designed primarily for throwing. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Light Hammer
description: A small throwing hammer. 2024 Mastery: Nick.

name: Mace
description: A heavy flanged metal club. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A stout length of treated hardwood. 2024 Mastery: Topple.

name: Sickle
description: A curved crescent blade used by farmers and druids. 2024 Mastery: Nick.

name: Spear
description: A short hafted spear suitable for melee thrusting or throwing. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Light Crossbow
description: A mechanical lever crossbow firing bolts. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Dart
description: A weighted throwing spike. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Shortbow
description: A compact curved bow. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Sling
description: A leather strap used to hurl lead bullets or stones. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Battleaxe
description: A broad-headed military axe with great chopping power. 2024 Mastery: Topple.

name: Flail
description: A spiked ball attached by a chain to a wooden handle. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Glaive
description: A single-edged blade affixed to the end of a long pole. 2024 Mastery: Graze.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive two-handed executioner's axe. 2024 Mastery: Cleave.

name: Greatsword
description: A formidable two-handed blade. 2024 Mastery: Graze.

name: Halberd
description: An axe blade topped with a spike and backed by a hook on a long shaft. 2024 Mastery: Cleave.

name: Lance
description: A long thrusting spear used on horseback. You have disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within 5 feet. 2024 Mastery: Topple.

name: Longsword
description: A knight's balanced double-edged sword. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Maul
description: A massive two-handed sledge designed to crush plate armor. 2024 Mastery: Topple.

name: Morningstar
description: A spiked metal ball mounted upon a shaft. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Pike
description: A long spear reaching up to 10 feet. 2024 Mastery: Push.

name: Rapier
description: A slender, sharply pointed sword focused on thrusting precision. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved slashing blade favoring quick, fluid strikes. 2024 Mastery: Nick.

name: Shortsword
description: A light dual-wielding thrusting blade. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Trident
description: A three-pronged spear favored by coastal warriors. 2024 Mastery: Topple.

name: War Pick
description: A sharp pointed pick head designed to puncture armor. 2024 Mastery: Sap.

name: Warhammer
description: A heavy bludgeoning war hammer with a spike on the reverse. 2024 Mastery: Push.

name: Whip
description: A braided leather lash. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Blowgun
description: A hollow tube for expelling poisoned needles silently. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Hand Crossbow
description: A compact one-handed crossbow. 2024 Mastery: Vex.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A powerful heavy crossbow requiring high crank tension. 2024 Mastery: Push.

name: Longbow
description: A tall wooden bow capable of devastating long-range volleys. 2024 Mastery: Slow.

name: Net
description: A weighted mesh to entangle Large or smaller targets. DC 10 Strength check or 5 slashing damage (AC 10) to escape.

name: Padded Armor
description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting. Gives Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: Leather Armor
description: Cured boiled leather breastplate with flexible shoulder guards.

name: Studded Leather Armor
description: Tough supple leather reinforced with close-set rivets and metal studs.

name: Hide Armor
description: Crude armor made from thick beast furs and cured pelts.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Interlocking metal rings worn between layers of quilted fabric. Concealable beneath clothing.

name: Scale Mail
description: Overlapping scales of bronze or steel sewn to a leather backing. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Breastplate
description: Fitted metal chest piece with back plate, leaving limbs completely free.

name: Half Plate Armor
description: Shaped steel plates covering most of the body except lower legs. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Ring Mail
description: Leather armor with heavy metal rings sewn into the surface. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Chain Mail
description: Full suit of interlocking steel rings over a quilted undergarment. Requires Strength 13. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Splint Armor
description: Vertical strips of steel riveted to a leather backing and chainmail. Requires Strength 15. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Plate Armor
description: Fitted, interlocking metal plates covering the entire body. Requires Strength 15. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Shield
description: A wooden or metal shield carried in one hand. Grants a +2 bonus to AC.

name: Backpack
description: A leather pack with 1 cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear capacity. Can strap a bedroll and rope.

name: Bedroll
description: A warm woolen blanket and water-resistant ground tarp for wilderness resting.

name: Crowbar
description: Using a crowbar grants advantage on Strength checks where the crowbar's leverage can be applied.

name: Grappling Hook
description: A metal three-pronged hook designed to be tied to a rope for climbing.

name: Healer's Kit
description: This kit has 10 uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 hit points, without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Holy Water (flask)
description: As an action, splash this water onto a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet. If the target is a fiend or undead, it takes 2d6 radiant damage.

name: Lantern (Bullseye)
description: Casts bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.

name: Lantern (Hooded)
description: Casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. As an action, you can lower the hood to reduce light to a 5-foot dim radius.

name: Oil (flask)
description: Covers a 5-foot square or creature. If lit before it dries (1 minute), deals 5 fire damage.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

name: Rope (hempen, 50 feet)
description: 50 feet of hemp rope. Has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

name: Rope (silk, 50 feet)
description: 50 feet of lightweight silk rope. Has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency lets you add proficiency bonus to lockpicking and trap-disarming.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: Contains pouches, clippers, mortar and pestle. Required to craft Antitoxin and Potions of Healing.

name: Poisoner's Kit
description: Glass vials, mortar and pestle, chemicals. Allows safe harvesting and brewing of poisons.

name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Beakers, pipettes, and reagents for synthesizing alchemical compounds, acids, and smoke powders.

name: Smith's Tools
description: Hammers, tongs, anvils, and files necessary to work metal and forge armaments.

name: Tinker's Tools
description: Precision hand tools, gears, wire, and calipers for crafting clocks, locks, and mechanical devices.

name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion. In 2024 rules, self-administration is a Bonus Action. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
description: You regain 10d4 + 20 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: Drinking this potion makes you invisible for 1 hour. Anything you wear or carry is invisible with you. The effect ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Potion of Speed
description: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no concentration required). The yellow fluid is agitated with a constant whirlwind motion.

name: Potion of Flying
description: Drinking this potion gives you a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour and the ability to hover.

name: Potion of Hill Giant Strength
description: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 21 for 1 hour. It has no effect on you if your Strength is already 21 or higher.

name: Potion of Fire Giant Strength
description: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 25 for 1 hour.

name: Elixir of Health
description: Cures any disease afflicting the drinker, and removes the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned conditions.

name: Oil of Sharpness
description: Coat a weapon or 5 pieces of ammunition. For 1 hour, the coated item is magical and grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while wearing this ring.

name: Ring of Spell Storing
description: This ring stores up to 5 levels of spells cast into it. Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 5th level into the ring by touching it as the spell is cast. The wearer can cast any spell stored in it using the original caster's save DC and spell attack bonus.

name: Ring of Resistance
description: You have resistance to one damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder) while wearing this ring.

name: Ring of Feather Falling
description: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

name: Ring of Free Action
description: While you wear this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be paralyzed or restrained.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible with you. You remain invisible until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible.

name: Ring of Evasion
description: Has 3 charges. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing it, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed instead. Regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Immovable Rod
description: This flat iron rod has a button on one end. As an action, you can press the button, and the rod instantly becomes magically fixed in place. It can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper +1
description: While holding this rod, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action once per long rest.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper +2
description: While holding this rod, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more charges to cast Magic Missile from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version; each additional charge increases the spell slot level by one. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges daily at dawn.

name: Wand of Fireballs
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to cast Fireball (DC 15). You can expend additional charges to increase the spell slot level. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges daily at dawn.

name: Wand of the War Mage +1
description: While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, your spell attacks ignore half cover.

name: Staff of the Magi
attunement: Requires Attunement by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
description: Grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC. Has 50 charges. Can absorb spells directed at you and unleash a massive retributive strike.

name: Staff of Healing
attunement: Requires Attunement by a Bard, Cleric, or Druid
description: Has 10 charges. Can expend charges to cast Cure Wounds (1 charge/level), Lesser Restoration (2 charges), or Mass Cure Wounds (5 charges). Regains 1d6 + 4 charges daily at dawn.

name: Weapon +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Weapon +2
description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Weapon +3
description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Flame Tongue
description: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. While blazing, it sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits.

name: Sun Blade
description: This longsword hilt blade is made of pure radiant sunlight. Deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage and has finesse. Grants +2 to attack and damage rolls, and deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage against undead.

name: Holy Avenger
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Deals an extra 2d10 radiant damage to fiends and undead. While holding the drawn sword, you and all allies within 10 feet (30 feet at paladin level 17) have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

name: Vorpal Sword
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. When you roll a 20 on an attack roll, you lop off one of the target's heads. If the creature cannot survive without its head, it dies instantly.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. When you hit a dragon with this weapon, the dragon takes an extra 3d6 damage of the weapon's type.

name: Armor +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this magic armor.

name: Armor +2
description: You have a +2 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this magic armor.

name: Shield +1
description: While holding this shield, you have a +3 total bonus to Armor Class (includes base +2 shield bonus).

name: Shield +2
description: While holding this shield, you have a +4 total bonus to Armor Class.

name: Adamantine Armor
description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Mithral Armor
description: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. A mithral chain shirt or breastplate can be worn under normal clothes. If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version does not.

name: Animated Shield
description: While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate and hover around you for 1 minute, protecting you as if you were wielding it while leaving both hands free.

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions: roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. It can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag always weighs 15 pounds regardless of contents.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

name: Boots of Speed
description: While wearing these boots, you can click your heels together as a bonus action to double your walking speed for up to 10 minutes. Any creature making an opportunity attack against you has disadvantage.

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
description: While wearing these boots, your walking speed becomes 30 feet unless your walking speed is higher, and your speed is not reduced if you are encumbered. In addition, you can jump three times the normal distance.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

name: Cloak of Displacement
description: While wearing this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place a few inches from your actual location. Attack rolls against you have disadvantage. If you take damage, the property is suppressed until the start of your next turn.

name: Amulet of Health
description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is 19 or higher.

name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
description: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than 21, the belt has no effect.

name: Bracers of Defense
description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
description: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize at the start of your turn if you are dying with 0 hit points. Whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, double the number of hit points restored.

name: Pearl of Power
description: While holding this pearl, you can use an action to speak its command word and regain one expended spell slot of up to 3rd level. Once used, cannot be used again until the next dawn.

name: Driftglobe
description: A 5-inch diameter sphere of blown glass. As an action, you can cast the Light spell or Daylight spell from it. You can command it to hover and follow you within 5 feet.

name: Goggles of Night
description: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

name: Winged Boots
description: While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use the boots to fly for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights.

name: Deck of Many Things
description: A legendary deck of 22 vellum cards engraved with arcane glyphs. Before drawing a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw. Cards drawn produce magical effects ranging from wish spells and grand castles to planar banishment and soul imprisonment.

name: Portable Hole
description: A 6-foot-wide circular cloth that can be unfolded onto any solid surface to create an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep. Can be folded up into a handkerchief.
